trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency of irregular serrations with low-to-medium pixel amplitude; jagged peaks are distributed continuously across the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory curving from the median notch toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips and multiple linear rake-mark abrasions visible on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated white circular focal spot visible on the interior region of the right lobe, separate from the distal clusters.
